title: CSCI 632 — Mobile Robot Programming
subject: Robotics
description: An independent, catalog-aligned learning companion. It is not an official RIT course section or a replacement for the instructor's syllabus.
outcomes: Define the core software architecture components of a mobile robot system, including sensing, state estimation, planning, control, and actuation.
Explain how ROS 2 message contracts, coordinate transforms, and timestamped observations enable reliable robot software communication.
Apply reactive motion control and path planning concepts to simulate and evaluate robot navigation in dynamic environments.
